summary: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business to the April 2018 Scarborough Community Council meeting, titled "the installation of Traffic Control Signals at the intersection of Eglinton Avenue East and Barbados Boulevard". I am requesting your support for the following motion: that Scarborough Community Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Eglinton Avenue East and Barbados Boulevard. As you may know, at the March 26th City Council, this motion was referred back to the April meeting of the Scarborough Community Council. The original request for new traffic control signals at this location dates back to almost a decade when reviewed by transportation staff in November, 2008. In September, 2015, Councillor Holland and I had requested that this area be reviewed again and have since had ongoing discussion with TTC and Transportation Staff on this issue. A traffic control signal in this area would allow a more efficient TTC route and would also provide a protected pedestrian crossover for passengers that make daily use of our bus network and for students and staff attending the new French Catholic School. If you have any questions regarding this matter please feel free to contact me at 416-392-0204.
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Eglinton Avenue East and Barbados Boulevard.
